title: Optimal Taxation of Inflation

authors: Capelle, Damien, Liu, Yang
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper analyzes the effectiveness of a tax on inflation policy (TIP), which would require firms to pay a tax proportional to the increase in their prices or wages, in stabilizing inflation. We show that TIP would effectively correct externalities in firms’ pricing decisions, tackle excessive inflation and reduce output volatility. While proposals from the 1970s saw TIP as a substitute to MP, we find that they are complementary, with TIP addressing cost-push shocks, and MP addressing demand shocks. In sharp contrast with price controls, TIP doesn’t exacerbate relative price distortions.

title: Racial and Ethnic Inequality and the China Shock

authors: Kahn, Lisa B., Oldenski, Lindsay, Park, Geunyong
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Minority workers tend to be disproportionately harmed by negative economic shocks. Indeed, we show that Hispanic populations experienced worse employment losses due to import competition from China, relative to whites, largely due to lower education levels. In contrast, Black-white employment and wage gaps actually narrowed due to relative growth in non-manufacturing sectors. We show that Black workers were less attached to manufacturing by 2000, compared to whites, and were therefore more poised to take advantage of China shock induced reallocation to services. The lasting negative impacts of the China shock on exposed communities were primarily driven by white workers.
abstract_zh: 少数族裔工人往往在经济负面冲击中遭受不成比例的损害。事实上，我们表明，相较于白人，西班牙裔人口因中国进口竞争而面临更严重的就业损失，这主要归因于其较低的教育水平。相比之下，由于非制造业部门的相对增长，黑人与白人之间的就业和工资差距实际上有所缩小。我们指出，到2000年，黑人工人对制造业的依赖程度低于白人，因此他们更有能力利用中国冲击所引发的服务业重新配置。中国冲击对受影响社区造成的持久负面影响主要由白人工人驱动。

title: Estimating present bias and sophistication over effort and money
title_zh: 估计努力和金钱上的现时偏向与成熟度
authors: Claudia Cerrone, Anujit Chakraborty, Hyok Jung Kim, Leonhard K. Lades
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We design and conduct a real-effort experiment to jointly estimate present bias and sophistication across effort and monetary domains. Unlike prior work (e.g.,Augenblick and Rabin, 2019; Fedyk, 2024), we do not assume that these parameters are identical across domains. We explain and empirically demonstrate how assuming identical sophistication across money and effort domains can bias the estimates of key parameters. In our online experiment, participants chose to (predicted to) complete 14% (10%) fewer tasks on the same day than on a future day, leading to an estimated present bias () is near zero, but there is substantial heterogeneity, with roughly equal numbers of participants exhibiting present bias and future bias. At the individual level, roughly three quarters of all participants correctly anticipate the direction of their bias in both domains, even if not its full magnitude.
abstract_zh: 我们设计并实施了一项真实努力实验，以联合估计努力领域和货币领域中的现时偏向与老练程度。与先前研究（如Augenblick and Rabin, 2019; Fedyk, 2024）不同，我们并未假设这些参数在不同领域间具有一致性。我们解释并实证证明了：假设货币与努力领域的老练程度相同，会导致关键参数估计产生偏误。在我们的在线实验中，参与者当天完成的任务量比未来某天少14%（预测值为10%），由此估算的现时偏向系数接近于零，但存在显著的异质性——表现出现时偏向与未来偏向的参与者数量大致相当。在个体层面，约四分之三的参与者能正确预判自身在两个领域中的偏向方向，尽管未能完全预判其程度。

title: Making Teenagers Read Newspapers. A Nationwide Experiment in French High Schools
title_zh: 让青少年阅读报纸：法国高中的全国性实验
authors: Simon Briole, Julia Cage, Andrea Prat, Simon Briole; Julia Cage; Andrea Prat
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Despite unprecedented access to information in the digital age, young citizens face growing challenges related to news consumption and misinformation. This large-scale randomized controlled trial examines the impact of two complementary interventions designed to foster media literacy and the consumption of high-quality news among high-school students, implemented in France over the 2024-25 academic year. The study involves 243 high schools (for a total number of 9,628 students), randomly assigned to a control group or to receive one or both of the following interventions: (i) a one-year free digital subscription to the leading national newspaper, and (ii) media education modules implemented by teachers. Exploiting unique data on students' actual online news consumption, we document a very large uptake of the free subscription, which translates into persistent and large increases in news consumption (+0.49 to 0.60 sd) and demand for future news, including an 8pp increase in paid subscriptions nearly a year after the intervention. We also observe a 0.20 to 0.31 sd increase in news knowledge for students enrolled in deprived schools, reducing baseline information inequality by 45-70%. Finally, we show that both free news access and media education improve media literacy skills (+0.08 to 0.26 sd), with larger effects among students taught by teachers with prior experience in media education.
abstract_zh: 尽管数字时代信息获取空前便捷，但年轻公民在新闻消费与应对虚假信息方面仍面临日益严峻的挑战。本项大规模随机对照试验考察了两项互补性干预措施的效果——旨在培养高中生媒介素养并促进高质量新闻消费，于2024-25学年在法国实施。研究涵盖243所高中（共计9,628名学生），随机分配至对照组或接受以下一项或两项干预：（i）为期一年的全国性主流报纸免费数字订阅；（ii）由教师实施的媒介教育模块。通过利用学生实际在线新闻消费的独特数据，我们发现免费订阅的采纳率极高，这转化为新闻消费的持续大幅增长（效应量0.49至0.60个标准差）及未来新闻需求的提升，包括干预实施近一年后付费订阅率增加8个百分点。在贫困学校就读的学生中，我们还观察到新闻知识水平提升0.20至0.31个标准差，使基线信息不平等程度降低45-70%。最后，研究表明免费新闻获取与媒介教育均能提升媒介素养技能（效应量0.08至0.26个标准差），且对由具备媒介教育经验的教师授课的学生影响更大。

authors: Ara Jo, Sébastien Houde
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper proposes corrected forecast combinations when the original combined forecast errors are serially dependent. Motivated by the classic Bates and Granger (1969) example, we show that combined forecast errors can be strongly autocorrelated and that a simple correction - adding a fraction of the previous combined error to the next-period combined forecast - can deliver sizable improvements in forecast accuracy, often exceeding the original gains from combining. We formalize the approach within the conditional-risk framework of Gibbs and Vasnev (2024), in which the combined error decomposes into a predictable component (measurable at the forecast origin) and an innovation. We then link this correction to efficient estimation of combination weights under time-series dependence via GLS, allowing joint estimation of weights and an error-covariance structure. Using the U.S. Survey of Professional Forecasters for major macroeconomic indices across various subsamples (including pre/post-2000, GFC, and COVID), we find that a parsimonious correction of the mean forecast with a coefficient around 0.5 is a robust starting point and often yields material improvements in forecast accuracy. For optimal-weight forecasts, the correction substantially mitigates the forecast combination puzzle by turning poorly performing out-of-sample optimal-weight combinations into competitive forecasts.

abstract: Abstract We examine how macroeconomic expectations affect consumer decisions, using an experiment with 2,872 credit card customers at a large commercial bank. In the experiment, participants are randomized into receiving expert forecasts of inflation and the nominal exchange rate. We find that forecasts shift inflation and exchange rate expectations, but do not change spending or self-reported consumption plans as predicted by standard models of intertemporal choice. Results from a supplementary survey experiment suggest that consumers are sophisticated enough to anticipate nominal rigidities and reduce spending on durables for precautionary reasons, counteracting the effects predicted by standard models of intertemporal optimization.
